note: Field States UI exposes Drupal's States API (#states) in Manage form display. A field state is a FieldState plugin (visible, invisible, required, optional, enabled, disabled, checked, unchecked, expanded, collapsed) with data {target, comparison, value}. State config is stored as a third-party setting on the widget's component in the entity_form_display config entity: content.<field>.third_party_settings.field_states_ui.field_states = list of {id, data:{target,comparison,value}, uuid}. No configure route, no permissions, no Drush. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config (exactly like a widget third-party setting): introspection reads which field has a state and its id/target; execution configures a state on a field's widget and a verify inspects the live entity_form_display component. Namespaced fields: field_fsui_known/state (medium), field_fsui_task+trigger and field_fsui_req (hard).

evals.prompt: What does the Field States UI (field_states_ui) Drupal module let you do without writing PHP, and name some of the field states it provides?
evals.expected_output: It exposes Drupal's form States API in the Manage form display UI, letting you make a field visible/invisible/required/optional/enabled/disabled/checked/unchecked/expanded/collapsed based on another field's value - no custom #states code needed.

evals.prompt: Where does field_states_ui store the states you configure for a field, i.e. in which config entity and under what key?
evals.expected_output: As a third-party setting on the field's widget component in the entity_form_display config entity: core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.field_states_ui.field_states, a list of {id, data:{target, comparison, value}, uuid}.

evals.prompt: For a single Field States UI state, what does the stored 'data' contain (which keys), and what is the module's plugin type called?
evals.expected_output: Each state's data has target (the watched field), comparison (value/empty/filled/checked/...), and value. Each state is a plugin of the module's FieldState plugin type (manager plugin.manager.field_states_ui.fieldstate, annotation @FieldState, base FieldStateBase).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field whose widget has a Field States UI state configured. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_fsui_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has third_party_settings.field_states_ui.field_states with a state (id visible, target title).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_fsui_state has a Field States UI state configured on its widget. Inspect the live default form display and report which field state (its id) is applied to it.
evals.expected_output: field_fsui_state has a field_states_ui state with id 'required' (data target title, comparison filled) in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has two text fields on its default form display: field_fsui_task and field_fsui_trigger. Using Field States UI, configure field_fsui_task's widget so it is only Visible when field_fsui_trigger has a value (a 'visible' state targeting field_fsui_trigger). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_fsui_task component's third_party_settings.field_states_ui.field_states contains an entry with id 'visible' and data.target 'field_fsui_trigger'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text field field_fsui_req on its default form display. Using Field States UI, configure field_fsui_req's widget with a 'required' field state (conditionally required based on another field). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_fsui_req component's third_party_settings.field_states_ui.field_states contains an entry with id 'required'.
